name: Sport Assists
source: [AS] Grade table proposal (assists plan I1, vault PHYS-074; owner approved the grade mapping 2026-10-12): Sport = traction control Off/On/Relaxed/Sport, plus launch control (assists I4). Mode 'on' is the car's own traction_control block. Per-mode values are assumed starting points (plan B1 table), measured against the V6 ordering band in tests/unit/test_assist_unit.cpp. Assists I4 (D-LC1): launch_control block - launch_rpm_fraction 0.55 of the engine's rev limiter [AS] (a generic unit that fits any engine; 0.55 x car_hyper's 8250 = 4538, close to the Racing unit's 4500); other numbers as the Racing unit (owner Q7 [AS] defaults, clutch regulator rates [AS]); default_enabled false [AS].
